clues: River channels here have a history that predates the mountains they cut through.
Karst features include a complex limestone cave system alongside deep canyons.
The protected landscape contains a great waterfall as well as boreal and alpine wildlife habitats.
It follows the South Nahanni River in Canada’s Northwest Territories.
Find the remote Canadian park whose river canyons and Virginia Falls lie north of the sixtieth parallel.
targetLabel: Nahanni National Park — designated property reference point
modernContext: UNESCO’s published representative point for the designated property, not its uniquely correct centre.
explanation: This river landscape illustrates that a river can maintain a course while mountains develop around it. Canyons, caves and a major waterfall give several independent geographical connections. The target is the UNESCO property’s reference point, not the entire river or an exact waterfall viewpoint.
dateLabel: First UNESCO World Heritage inscription year, not the age of the natural feature
cultures: Physical geography, conservation and scientific study
uncertainty: Source-checked authoring only; independent factual, English and clue-order review is pending. The point represents the designated property, not every part of a large natural feature.
